Game Overview

In Fart Pig, the core idea is straightforward: join the hilarious world of Fart Pig, where you build a fart empire by collecting points through pig-powered farts. Upgrade, unlock quirky new pigs, and discover advanced technologies in a whimsical quest for greatness in this engaging and addictive clicker game.
